title: International territorial level 1, January 2021 (United Kingdom, generalised, clipped)
description: The twelve ITL1 areas: the nine English regions plus Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. The top tier of the geography that replaced NUTS for UK economic statistics.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "International_Territorial_Level_1_January_2021_UK_BGC_2022" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/International_Territorial_Level_1_January_2021_UK_BGC_2022/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 12 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
